result.summary: The page appears largely functional and visually consistent. No critical blockers are visible; findings are minor layout/accessibility concerns around clipped horizontal content and muted text contrast.

issues.description: Horizontally scrolling restaurant cards and category chips are visibly clipped at the right edge with no clear scroll affordance, which can make content look accidentally cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade, peek spacing, or a scroll indicator and ensure truncated card titles remain understandable.

issues.description: Search placeholder text and some secondary metadata use light gray on near-white backgrounds, which may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of placeholder/metadata text to meet WCAG AA contrast guidance.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' restaurant name is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol…', reducing scannability.
issues.suggestion: Use ellipsis with accessible full label, widen cards slightly, or allow title wrap to two lines.
